symbols.name: half-length output index
symbols.meaning: The output index of a transform of length q/2, running from 0 to q/2 minus 1.
symbols.quote: Let $\varsigma$ be the half-length output index, the output index of a transform of length $q/2$, with $0 \le \varsigma < q/2$.

symbols.name: pair sums
symbols.meaning: The sequence of q/2 sums f_s + f_{s+q/2}, indexed by s from 0 to q/2 minus 1.
symbols.quote: For $0 \le s < q/2$, put $\tilde f_s = f_s + f_{s+q/2}$ and $\check f_s = \omega^s\,(f_s - f_{s+q/2})$.

symbols.name: twisted pair differences
symbols.meaning: The sequence of q/2 values omega^s times (f_s minus f_{s+q/2}), indexed by s from 0 to q/2 minus 1.
symbols.quote: For $0 \le s < q/2$, put $\tilde f_s = f_s + f_{s+q/2}$ and $\check f_s = \omega^s\,(f_s - f_{s+q/2})$.

relations.quote: The transform is built from [Butterfly](butterfly.md) maps arranged in $\lg q$ layers.
Radix-two factorization computes a [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) of length $q$, when $q$ is a power of two.
